earnings.title: Media Contact: Patrick Reynolds
highlights: Sempra is also affirming a 7% to 9% projected long‑term EPS growth rate.

quotes.text: Our year-to-date results reflect disciplined execution across the company and continued progress on our 2026 value creation initiatives.

outlook: The transaction to sell a 45% equity interest in Sempra Infrastructure Partners to affiliates of KKR remains on track and is expected to close in the next two weeks.

items.heading: Sempra’s ability to pay dividends and meet its obligations largely depends on the performance of its subsidiaries and entities accounted for as equity method investments.
Our investments in businesses we do not control expose us to risks.
Our business could be negatively affected by activist shareholders.
Successfully executing our five-year capital expenditures plan is subject to risks.
Settlement provisions contained in forward sale agreements in connection with our ATM program subject us to certain risks.
The economic interest, voting rights and market value of our outstanding common stock may be adversely affected by any additional equity securities we may issue.
